description: This file defines a class ScopeEntity that implements the ScopeEntityInterface for OAuth2 scope management within the OrangeHRM project. It provides a concrete implementation with a constructor and a getter method for the scope identifier.

classes.name: ScopeEntity
classes.description: Concrete implementation of OAuth2 ScopeEntityInterface, representing a scope with an identifier in the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ScopeEntity with a specified scope identifier.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the scope.
